text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · SUN 18 OCT ₿ BTC $81,906 (+0.6%) · ETH $2,418 (+0.8%) · Fear & Greed 53 🇮🇳 NIFTY 23,146 (+0.7%) · SENSEX 74,729 (+0.6%) at Friday's close 📉 $907M left US spot bitcoin ETFs in two weeks, per Farside. Week one (5-9 Oct) lost $679M, with $485M of it on 7 October alone. 🔢 The selling slowed. Week two (12-16 Oct) lost $228M, about a third of week one, even with a hot US inflation print on Wednesday. Bitcoin dipped to $79,709 on Thursday on Kraken, then closed every day above $81,300. 🗓️ The Fed decides in 10 days, on 27-28 October. Core inflation is at 2.6%, above forecast, so another hike is on the table. Fear & Greed has cooled from 63 on Friday to 53. Write your plan for a hike and for a hold before the week starts. 🇮🇳 India's ED followed fraud money into crypto. It searched 20 premises in five cities over two betting apps and named crypto as one of three routes money left India, next to fake trade bills and mule accounts. Never rent out your bank account or KYC. The Sensex rose for a second day on Friday, up 414 to 74,729, with IT stocks up about 4%. 📊 Want a coin charted?
